title: Rope exit - diegetic hatch climb / gate delve (option A 2026-11-03)
purpose: Diegetic exits: Climb = hatch/shaft + rope coil hotspots; Delve = floor-planted gate hotspot. No Climb/Delve chrome plank buttons. Left sign is flavor only. Title band + cleared headline stay. Climb anim UP shaft; Delve anim RIGHT into gate. Plant coords measured from Nathan F5 + Pixel annot.
component: FitLabelBox: NinePatchRect frame (optional) + Label child. Label rect = text_rect. Fit order: size font_max -> shrink by 2 px to font_min -> autowrap (word) up to max_lines -> ellipsis + full text in HoverTag. Text only via KIT.copy_text(key)/fill_text(key,args).
font: project default (ThemeDB fallback). Same face, sizes, and colours as ac767cd. Do not load assets/ui/fonts.
